## Milestone `ms-codebase-atlas` — "Codebase Atlas — system design lenses + AI copilot" · 84h

| # | sub-task | est | gate (deps) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `atlas-shell-and-file-map` — Atlas destination + `/api/bridza/atlas/scan` + treemap lens + shared selection | 8 | — |
| 2 | `atlas-module-dependency-graph` — import graph, cycles, orphans | 10 | AND: 1 |
| 3 | `atlas-runtime-container-diagram` — C4-style runtime topology, edges derived from routes/spawns | 8 | AND: 1 |
| 4 | `atlas-request-flow-map` — per-operation sequence lens (UI→client→route→store→git) | 7 | AND: 1 |
| 5 | `atlas-git-history-lens` — churn heat, timeline scrubber, co-change graph | 10 | AND: 1 |
| 6 | `atlas-docs-knowledge-lens` — docs/ADR ↔ code links, stale + broken-link flags | 6 | AND: 1 |
| 7 | `atlas-ask-ai-about-selection` — click node → scoped AI ask, streamed, context pack | 10 | AND: 1 |
| 8 | `atlas-ai-chat-thread-citations` — multi-turn thread, persisted, two-way citations | 8 | AND: 7 |
| 9 | `atlas-ai-architecture-overview` — AI-written `docs/atlas/overview.md` + area briefs, staleness | 6 | AND: 7 |
| 10 | `atlas-export-and-embed` — SVG/PNG/Mermaid export, save to repo | 5 | AND: 1 · **OR: 2,3,4,5** |
| 11 | `atlas-scan-cache-and-ignore` — incremental cache, ignore config, file cap | 6 | AND: 1 |

Critical path: 1 → 7 → 8 = **26h**. Lenses 2–6, 10, 11 fan out in parallel after 1.

Slicing rationale: each slice is a vertical strip (scanner + endpoint + lens + tests), not a layer. #1 is the only true prerequisite — it ships the destination, the scan API and the selection model, and is useful alone. AI is not a phase bolted on the end: #7 lands as soon as one lens exists, because the intent's core ask is "point at a box and ask about it". #10 uses an OR gate — any one diagram lens makes export valuable.

Grounded in the actual repo, not generic: reuses `CanvasNode`/`layoutNodes`/`useCanvasOverrides` for graphs, the `bridge.js` route pattern + `client.js` stream helper for endpoints, the existing agent runner (claude/opencode) for AI — no new provider, no API keys, no new diff or file-open mechanism.

## Merge into `main`

**Will be clean.** `git log main..HEAD` is empty — the branch sits exactly at `main`, and every change here is new files plus an additive tail-append to `.bridza/plan.json` (verified by diff: no existing `deps`, `milestones`, `est`, `pos`, `sizes`, `links` or `pipeDeps` entry modified or removed). All sub-task `metadata.json` carry `"target": "main"`. Only residual risk: if `main` gains a competing `plan.json` edit before finalize, the conflict would be confined to the `deps`/`milestones`/`est` tail regions and resolves by keeping both sides.

Caveat I could not close: JSON syntax validation via `node`/`python3` was blocked by the sandbox in this session, so plan.json validity is confirmed by diff inspection (balanced braces, correct comma placement) rather than a parser run.
